name: Banking Hero
description: A digital-banking hero: a left heading with an accent squiggle, a right sub and dark demo button, then a three-card row (a large Personal card with a photo and a floating account widget, plus narrow Business and Freelance gradient cards with vertical labels).
interactions: the three plan cards are an expanding row: one is open at a time (Personal starts open), the others collapse to vertical-label tiles; opening animates flex-grow over 550ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) while the collapsed label cross-fades out and the content + arrow fade in
clicking, hovering, or pressing Enter/Space on a card opens it (aria-selected tracks state)
header and cards fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver, wpmn-bh-up 600ms, cards staggered 80/160ms)
under 900px the row stacks vertically (labels horizontal); prefers-reduced-motion turns transitions off and shows the open card
